title: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 — historical statute

content.citation: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 — historical concordance after 1 July 2024; see BNSS s. 531 savings

currentLawCheck.note: BNSS commenced on 1 July 2024. The CrPC is retained for historical/concordance purposes and for matters governed by applicable savings/transition provisions; do not present it as the default current criminal-procedure statute.
